Class OidcTokenExchangeGrant

java.lang.Object
iu.oidc.client.OidcTokenGrant
iu.oidc.client.OidcTokenExchangeGrant
public class OidcTokenExchangeGrant extends OidcTokenGrant
Exchanges an access token for one answering for somebody else, through the RFC 8693 token exchange grant.

The second half of a two-step flow. An application authorizes its end user normally, and holds an access token they are the subject of; to act as somebody else it presents that token here as the actor_token and names who it wants to answer for. What comes back has the named principal as its subject and the original end user as its act claim, so a resource server can tell the action was delegated and a relying party can show its user whose session they are looking through.

The subject is asserted, not proven: nobody holds a token for the party being impersonated, which is the point of asking. What authorizes the exchange is the role held by the principal the actor_token was issued to, which is why a provider only honors this outside production.

The exchanged token is deliberately narrower than the one that bought it. Its scope cannot exceed what the presented token already carries, and no refresh token descends from it — an impersonated session is extended by exchanging again, while the token it descends from is still good, rather than by refreshing on its own.

    • isAuthTimeRequired

      protected boolean isAuthTimeRequired()
      Description copied from class: OidcTokenGrant
      Determines whether an ID token this grant receives must state when its subject, or the actor behind them, authenticated.

      True for every grant that descends from an end user signing in, since a maximum authentication age cannot be enforced against an authentication the token never dates. OidcTokenExchangeGrant overrides this, because a provider that has not yet started dating its access tokens gives an exchange nothing true to carry — and an exchange is refused outright in production, so tolerating that is not a production concession.

      Whether it is required or not, a maximum age is enforced against whatever the token does state.

      Overrides:
      isAuthTimeRequired in class OidcTokenGrant
      Returns:
      true to refuse an ID token stating no authentication time
